description: A check before a risky tool call runs; the call waits for a human decision instead of executing.
A run that returns early with its pending calls and serializable state, instead of blocking while a human decides.
Everything needed to resume a run (conversation, step count, pending calls) as plain JSON, without functions, class instances or secrets.
The three decisions on a pending call: run it as proposed, refuse it with a reason, or run it with corrected arguments.
Approval that depends on the call's arguments, such as refunds above a threshold, instead of on the tool alone.
When reviewers see too many requests and approve without reading, so the gate stops protecting anything.
